evals.prompt: /dockerhddm-workflow 我有 trial-level CSV，想比较 condition 是否影响 v。请初始化项目并生成可运行的拟合、诊断、PPC 与模型比较代码。
evals.expected_output: Creates an inference project, validates seconds/coding/cells, fits a baseline before a v-by-condition model, stages sample and to_infdata, saves artifacts, and includes convergence plus absolute-fit checks.
assertions: Does not pass n_jobs to model.sample
Checks rt units and response coding

evals.prompt: /dockerhddm-workflow 我还没有数据，但理论预测 easy 条件的 v 高于 hard。生成多组参数、模拟 40 人每条件 200 trials，做参数恢复并画图。
evals.expected_output: Creates a simulation project, reads model_config bounds, records seed and ground truth, generates conditions, refits the planned model, and reports bias/RMSE/coverage with behavioral and recovery plots.
assertions: Uses simulation rather than posterior inference as the first step
Records parameter order, bounds, seed, and truth

evals.prompt: /dockerhddm-workflow 100个被试每人1000试次，PPC/loglike时 kernel died。诊断并给安全代码。
evals.expected_output: Estimates memory, explains trace/PPC/loglike/merge multipliers, keeps n_jobs out of sample, stages to_infdata with bounded n_ppc and n_jobs=1, and discusses subsampled LOO plus WSL swap.
assertions: Does not imply more RAM fixes invalid modeling
Recommends the OOM article with a source-level caveat

evals.prompt: /dockerhddm-workflow 我计划每条件40次试验、正确率98%，能否估计 sv、sz、st 并解释组间差异？
evals.expected_output: Flags sparse errors and likely poor identifiability, cites experimental-design guidance, recommends design-specific recovery across trial/participant counts, and advises a simpler model or redesigned task before interpretation.
assertions: Does not promise recovery from successful sampling
